theorems.name: Submission.slicing_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W < ∞ ∧ T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U m, IsSlice T f t S
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
